item.title: Illit scales back comeback promotions amid members' health concerns
item.description:
Korea Herald • Comeback / release
K-pop girl group Illit will scale back promotional activities for its fifth EP, "Break Even," as four of its five members face health issues, the group's agency Belift Lab announced Wednesday. In a notice posted on the group's official fan platform, the agency said Yunah, Minju and Wonhee recently visited hospitals after experiencing high fevers and body aches. item.description:
Korea Herald • Debut / new group

item.title: CL to return with new single on Nov. 20
item.description:
Korea Herald • Comeback / release
CL will release the digital single “Iconic” on Nov. 20, marking her first solo release in five years. The Black Label unveiled concept photos for the upcoming single through its official social media channels late Monday, days after announcing that CL had signed an exclusive contract with the agency. item.title: Former Ador CEO referred to prosecutors over NewJeans' attempted contract termination
item.description:
Korea Herald • Contract / agency
Seoul Mapo Police Station referred Min Hee-jin, former CEO of K-pop agency Ador and current head of Ooak Records, to prosecutors Monday on suspicion of breach of trust over her alleged involvement in NewJeans' attempt to terminate its exclusive contracts with the agency in 2024. Min denied the allegations and questioned how details of the police investigation had reached the media before she was formally notified of the decision.
